{"explanation": "This invoice from Klipspruit Engineering Supplies (Pty) Ltd (F-26-0992, PO-IPAGE4PZA5) was held because the tax charged is 13,749.01 ZAR, but the PO tax rate of 10.00% implies 9,166.01 ZAR, a difference of 4,583.00 ZAR. Please check whether the vendor applied a different tax rate or included items not covered by the PO, and confirm the correct tax amount against the PO before deciding how to proceed.", "email_subject": "Tax amount query on invoice F-26-0992 (PO-IPAGE4PZA5)", "email_body": "Dear Klipspruit Engineering Supplies team,

Thank you for invoice F-26-0992 dated 2026-03-13 for a total of ZAR 105,409.07, referencing PO-IPAGE4PZA5.

When we checked the invoice against the purchase order, the tax amount of ZAR 13,749.01 does not match the 10.00% tax rate on the PO, which gives ZAR 9,166.01. The difference is ZAR 4,583.00.

Could you please review this and either send a corrected invoice or confirm the tax calculation and applicable rate? We will process the invoice once this is resolved.

Thank you for your help.

Kind regards,
Accounts Payable"}
